entities.name: Batkhuyagiin Möngöntuul
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Batkhuyag Munguntuul is a Mongolian chess player who holds the FIDE titles of International Master (IM) and Woman Grandmaster (WGM). She competed in the Women's World Chess Championship in 2008 and 2010.
